title: GitHub Copilot Billing & Premium-Request Watch
blurb: A running record of changes to the GitHub documentation pages that define how GitHub Copilot is billed — premium-request multipliers, included monthly allowances by plan, and overage rules. GitHub docs do not publish a machine-readable "last updated" date, so changes here are detected from the page body itself and tracked from the day monitoring began.
